headlines.title: 3 AI Stocks With Earnings Growth Of Up To 98%
headlines.summary: Anthropic is offering Blackstone a yield above 10% to fund a massive AI chip buildout, a sign that the easy money phase of artificial intelligence is giving way to businesses that must earn their keep. High borrowing costs punish cash burners and reward companies already turning AI spending into profits. This article highlights three profitable AI players from our screener that show how that shift is playing out.

headlines.title: Lumentum Is Sold Out Through 2029. Wedbush Thinks That Could Be Bullish for GlobalFoundries. Is It?
headlines.summary: Lumentum’s components are sold out through 2029, and Wedbush called the tight supply bullish for suppliers and foundries, naming GlobalFoundries among potential beneficiaries.

headlines.title: Earnings Preview: What to Expect From Lumentum’s Report
headlines.summary: Lumentum is scheduled to report its Q1 earnings next month, with analysts projecting robust triple-digit year-over-year EPS growth.

headlines.title: How Risky Is Lumentum Stock?
headlines.summary: Shares of Lumentum (LITE) fell 19.3% in the week to October 14. The retreat came despite upbeat comments from management earlier in the week, which had briefly sent the stock higher. Even with that drop, the stock remains up 458% over the past year, compared with a 17.3% gain for the S&P 500. Buyers at today's price appear to be betting that Lumentum can continue to manufacture and profit from the optical and laser components AI data centers want.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
